law_name: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 6-I of 10 June 1996 on Copyright and Related Rights
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (anonymous/pseudonymous works: 70 years from lawful publication)
digital_protection: Technical protection means & rights-management information protected (art. 48)
fair_use_exceptions: Closed list (arts. 18-26): personal copying, quotation, teaching, libraries, reprography
enforcement_body: Ministry of Justice (Committee on Intellectual Property Rights; National Institute of Intellectual Property)
